source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend eligible monochrome diagonal segments to obstacles or edges."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in out for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in out))
    runs = []
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = out[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and out[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                cells = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == color:
                    cells.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(cells) >= 2:
                    runs.append((color, dr, dc, cells[0], cells[-1]))
    # A single matching diagonal is not enough to mark the pattern as a set of rays.
    if len(runs) < 2:
        return out
    for color, dr, dc, (r0, c0), (r1, c1) in runs:
        rr, cc = r0 - dr, c0 - dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr -= dr
            cc -= dc
        rr, cc = r1 + dr, c1 + dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr += dr
            cc += dc
    return out
'''
